Construction Services in Eastborough, KS

Eastborough is a small, affluent incorporated village of roughly 800 residents in east Wichita — entirely surrounded by the city but maintaining its own government, zoning, and permit structure. The community is known for its estate-sized lots, mature tree canopy, and housing stock that tends toward larger, higher-quality custom homes. Many Eastborough homes were built in the mid-20th century on substantial lots and have seen multiple rounds of updating over the decades.

Wheatland Construction serves Eastborough. We permit through the Village of Eastborough's building office for all work within city limits, and we understand that renovation and building standards in an area like Eastborough demand attention to detail and quality of execution that matches the character of the neighborhood.

What We Build in Eastborough

Custom Homes

Eastborough has limited infill opportunities given its built-out character, but teardown-rebuild projects and substantial additions exist. We build to the elevated standards the community expects — attention to exterior materials, roofline integration, and finish quality that fits in Eastborough's established streetscape. See Custom Home Building in Eastborough →

Home Additions

Eastborough's larger lots have room to expand — and the elevated home values in the area make a well-executed addition a strong investment. Master suite additions, two-story expansions, and sunroom or screened-porch additions are common projects here. We match existing brick, stone, and roofline details precisely so the addition feels original. See Home Additions in Eastborough →

Basement Finishing

Many Eastborough homes were built with full basements — some finished in previous renovation cycles and now due for a full update, some left unfinished and ready for their first buildout. We assess existing conditions, address moisture where present, and build finished spaces that match the quality standard of the rest of the home. See Basement Finishing in Eastborough →

Bathroom Remodeling

Eastborough homes frequently have bathrooms that were renovated in the 1980s or 1990s that no longer reflect the home's overall quality standard. We remodel Eastborough bathrooms to a standard that fits the home — quality tile, quality fixtures, appropriate material selections for the price point. See Bathroom Remodeling in Eastborough →

Kitchen Remodeling

Eastborough kitchens from previous renovation decades — 1980s oak, 1990s granite tile, early 2000s granite slab — can get dated quickly. We remodel Eastborough kitchens with layouts and finishes appropriate for the home's scale and value, from cabinetry and countertops through appliances and lighting. See Kitchen Remodeling in Eastborough →

Major Remodels

Eastborough's older custom homes are ideal candidates for comprehensive renovation — larger scopes that address multiple rooms or floors at once, bringing homes built in the 1950s and 1960s into alignment with contemporary expectations for layout, insulation, and finish. See Major Remodels in Eastborough →

Roofing

East Wichita's established tree canopy can create wind and debris considerations during storm events. Eastborough homes frequently have complex rooflines with multiple valleys and dormers that require skilled installation. We install roofing systems that handle Eastborough's architectural complexity and the Kansas hail and wind environment. See Roofing in Eastborough →

Eastborough Permit Office

All residential construction in Eastborough permits through the Village of Eastborough's building office — not the City of Wichita. We handle all applications and inspections through the appropriate jurisdiction.

Why Eastborough Homeowners Choose Wheatland

We understand that construction in Eastborough needs to meet a higher standard — in quality of execution, in materials selection, and in attention to how the work integrates with the existing home and neighborhood character. Written estimates, own crews, no shortcuts.
